title: Perfect day in a breathtaking environment
text: Excellent experience from start to finish
author: F5485JMtoma

title: Great tour!
text: We had Brian as our tour guide and really enjoyed our tour. It was so interesting learning the history of the area and seeing the beauty of Montserrat. The hike was “easy” but in the sense that it’s mostly downhill. My older travel partner didn’t find it as “easy” as I did because it was quite steep in some areas. If you have bad knees or otherwise find it difficult to walk down steep slopes you may not want to join that part of the tour. But you can still ride the funicular up the hill and then take it back down to wait on the group.  Be sure to wear good shoes that hold your toes in place or
author: christinawV8254DU

title: Worth it
text: The half day trip was excellent. Knowledgeable guide. Good balance of history and scenery. Worth the money for the experience for sure. Need to be reasonable health in terms of walking as you’re doing some steep steps.
author: TN10000

title: Highly recommend
text: Lovely experience and our guide David was fabulous. Very informative and well worth the trip.  The hike is nice and the whole experience is worth the one hour drive up and back.
author: Julie_M

title: Fantastic Day Tour
text: Jaume was an exceptional guide - knowledgeable, considerate (my wife and I were by far the oldest of the group) and enthusiastic. Well worth the time and money spent.
author: cvmini

title: Great tour and guide David
text: Was a great tour made even better by a great guide who was knowledgeable, nice and considerate with everyone’s needs.
author: Christopher_T

title: We had an amazing...
text: We had an amazing experience …views were absolutely breathtaking, and the hike was such a memorable part of the experience. Our tour guide was fantastic, knowledgeable, friendly, and made the whole trip even more enjoyable. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience and would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting the area!
author: Tammy_H

title: Outstanding tour of Montserrat!
text: Our guide Jordy was incredibly knowledgeable and kind. He did not rush our group and was ensuring everyone, especially the senior members of the group, were safe. The hike down from Montserrat is quite steep and good footwear is needed as well as a water bottle.
author: Christine_D

title: Excellent half day out of the city!
text: One of the best guided trips! Our guide (shamefully I’ve forgotten his name) was excellent, with so much knowledge of not only the monastery, but the landscape and nature that surround it. Even with some fog, the views were incredible. Don’t give this a miss!!l
author: Megan_R

title: MUST DO EXPERIENCE!!!
text: This was one of the highlights of our six day stay in Barcelona!  Communication of meeting point and punctuality was excellent. Our guide, George/Jordi was extremely knowledgeable with culture, monestery history, and all aspects of the area. He took great care with his driving and hiking skills. His personality made the experience most enjoyable. He had a wonderful sense of humor and kept our group engaged.
